channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: “No Brasil há radicalização, não polarização”, diz Temer ao lançar filme
item.description: Former Brazilian president Michel Temer stated that Brazil is experiencing political radicalization, not polarization, during the launch of the documentary '967 Days', directed by Bruno Barreto. He criticized the division in social and institutional relations but defended the resilience of democracy. The film, set to premiere in the second half of 2026, aims to portray his government faithfully and position him as a moderate figure in a context of radicalization.

item.title: O recado de Lula ao bolsonarismo no estado mais bolsonarista do país
item.description: Lula visited Santa Catarina, where Jair Bolsonaro received 69% of the vote in 2022, and criticized Governor Jorginho Mello for allegedly rejecting a proposed federal partnership worth R$ 24 billion. He emphasized the need to govern for all Brazilians regardless of electoral outcomes and urged voters to compare federal and state government performance alongside his allies Décio Lima and Gelson Merísio.

item.title: Comparem quem trouxe benefício para o povo e quem só falou bobagem, questiona Lula
item.description: President Lula defended his third term, claiming his policies delivered concrete benefits to the people, while accusing his opponents of merely speaking nonsense. He made the remarks in Itajaí, SC, during a visit to offshore support vessel projects contracted by Petrobras at the Detroit Brasil shipyard.

item.title: SC: Lula critica governador por recusar parcerias com governo federal
item.description: President Lula criticized Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello for refusing federal partnerships, including a R$24 billion highway project, and questioned his 'brain mass quality'. Lula noted that Mello, a Bolsonaro ally, has avoided federal events despite federal investments in the state, accusing him of prioritizing personal and political interests over the needs of Santa Catarina's population.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio faz aceno às mulheres após atrito com Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reached out to women on Instagram following a disagreement with Michelle Bolsonaro, sharing a clip from an interview with Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa Econômica Federal. The move aims to ease family tensions and strengthen his electoral appeal among female voters.

item.title: Lula critica Jorginho, cita Hitler e diz para 'acabar com racismo' em SC
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello for opposing racial quota policies, even comparing his stance to Adolf Hitler's ideology when discussing racism in the state. Lula emphasized the need to combat structural racism and reaffirmed the importance of affirmative actions to promote racial equality.

item.title: TSE confirma remoção de ‘deepfake’ eleitoral contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously confirmed the removal of an X post using a deepfake to falsely associate Senator Flávio Bolsonaro with Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, presenting the image as a 'leaked photo'. Minister André Mendonça had ordered the removal, ruling it constitutes anticipatory negative electoral propaganda by misleading voters about a politically relevant fact, while affirming that sharp political criticism remains protected under democratic debate.

item.title: Ex-ministra de Lula narra em livro embates com Bolsonaro na pandemia
item.description: Former Health Minister Nísia Trindade will launch her book 'Still Time: The Covid-19 Pandemic and the Transformation of the Future' this Saturday (27) at Megafauna in São Paulo. The work recounts her clashes with the Bolsonaro government during the pandemic, highlighting challenges in managing the health crisis and lessons for the future.

item.title: Bolsonaro apresenta “picos hipertensivos” e recebe doses extras de medicação
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro experienced hypertensive spikes in recent days and received extra doses of medication to control them, according to a weekly medical report submitted by his defense to Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The document, signed by cardiologist Brasil Ramos Caiado, was filed with the STF on Friday, April 12.

item.title: O balanço que a equipe de marketing de Flávio fez da briga com Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's marketing team assessed that the public feud with Michelle Bolsonaro did not harm his campaign, as most social media mentions focused on the former first lady, not the senator. They noted no evidence of conservative female voters shifting away and observed that Michelle is increasingly being referred to by her maiden name, Michelle Firmo, and associated with terms like 'betrayal' and 'attempting to tumultuate' the campaign, suggesting an effort to distance her from the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: ANÁLISE: Michelle se coloca como player no jogo político e manda recado dizendo que não será escanteada
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro positions herself as an independent political actor by publishing videos exposing her rift with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, emphasizing that her discourse aligns with Jair Bolsonaro’s and that she has her own base, not relying on the ex-president’s sons. She warns that underestimating her is a political mistake, especially as a woman in politics, and that her adversaries will not forget her.

item.title: Ruas repete Flávio e defende bombardeio dos EUA contra traficantes na costa brasileira
item.description: The president of the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly and pre-candidate for state governor, Douglas Ruas (PL), advocated in a BBC News interview that the United States carry out bombings against drug traffickers' vessels in open sea off the Brazilian coast, repeating a proposal previously made by Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Vídeo: Ao vivo: Sessão solene presta homenagem ao Dia do Policial Legislativo – 26/6/26
item.description: The video shows the live broadcast of a solemn session at the Federal Senate honoring Legislative Police Day, celebrated on June 26, 2026. The ceremony recognized the work of security professionals serving in the Legislative Power, with speeches from authorities and security force representatives. The content also includes sharing links for social media and a list of other recent Senate videos on topics such as the 2026 elections, health, elderly care, and LGBTQIA+ issues.

item.title: Governo regulamenta FGTS como garantia do consignado e limita juros a 1,99% ao mês
item.description: The Lula government has regulated the use of FGTS and severance funds as collateral for private payroll-dedicated loans, allowing up to 35% of severance pay, 100% of the FGTS severance fine, and 10% of the FGTS account balance (only for workers opting for severance withdrawal). Interest rates are capped at 1.99% per month for new credit, refinancing, and portability, excluding renegotiations. The rule takes effect upon publication, with implementation pending technological and operational readiness by the Ministry of Labor.

item.title: Flávio visita Bolsonaro após crise com Michelle
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, is expected to visit former President Jair Bolsonaro in Brasília this Friday, the 26th, following a public crisis involving former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro. The meeting takes place amid growing strain within the Bolsonaro family and ahead of a Supreme Federal Court decision related to the former president.

item.title: Crusoé: “Está cheio de nego maluco no mundo”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula said the world is full of 'crazy people,' which justifies increased defense spending in Brazil. He announced that defense will be included in his 2026 re-election campaign platform and mentioned that U.S. President Donald Trump wants to take over the Panama Canal, though the statement was cut off.

item.title: ‘Único erro de Jaques Wagner é cuidar de pobre’, diz governador da Bahia
item.description: Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues defended Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) at a public event in Barreiras, claiming the senator’s only 'mistake' was caring for the poor, which allegedly provoked political persecution. Wagner, under PF investigation for alleged bribes from Banco Master, was proclaimed innocent by Rodrigues, despite Wagner himself admitting in a Folha de S.Paulo interview that the actual amounts may exceed the R$ 3.5 million cited in the investigation.

item.title: A oportunidade encontrada por Michelle na disputa pela herança política de Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro stated she was disrespected and sidelined from party decisions by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, her stepson, after a harsh phone call in which he told her to stay out of party deliberations. Despite the conflict, she later downplayed the feud, saying there is no rivalry and urging unity to defeat the Lula government. According to José Benedito da Silva, the tension is longstanding, rooted in Flávio’s selection as successor without consulting Michelle, which has undermined her campaign involvement and damaged the PL’s standing with female and evangelical voters.

item.title: Valdemar sobre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Se não nos entendermos, vamos perder a eleição'
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party, warned that the rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro could cost the party the 2026 election and keep Jair Bolsonaro imprisoned for another ten years. He stressed the need for internal unity to avoid defeat.

item.title: Enquanto Marília resiste, Correa diz que aceitaria missão de Lula em MG
item.description: Federal deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) announced his pre-candidacy for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies but stated he would step aside if the Minas Gerais PT decided to launch its own gubernatorial candidacy. He emphasized that defeating Bolsonarism and re-electing Lula is the party’s priority, and he would support any strategy — including backing Marília Campos, who insists on running for the Senate and opposes the PT’s own candidacy plan.

item.title: Flávio atuou contra o Brasil e agora tenta consertar, diz Alckmin
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro acted against Brazil's interests by defending the maintenance of U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, criticizing the Bolsonaro family's role in trade negotiations. He added that the government is working to reverse the tariffs and EU restrictions on Brazilian beef, with technical teams holding weekly talks with the U.S. and coordinated efforts across ministries to resolve the issue before September.

item.title: Jaques Wagner diz a jornal que reclamou a Lula de 'patacoada' da PF
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) criticized the Federal Police, calling their search and seizure operation against him a 'blunder', and said he discussed the 'narrative' of the case with President Lula. The remarks were made in an interview with Folha de S.Paulo published on Friday, the 26th.

item.title: Lula cita Trump e defende reforço militar: 'Não quero ser pego de surpresa'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced he will strengthen Brazil’s national defense capacity and include the topic in his government program for the first time. Citing former U.S. President Donald Trump as an example of a leader who prioritizes national security, Lula said he does not want to be 'caught off guard' by external threats.

item.title: Lula diz que vai incluir defesa nacional em plano de governo: 'Está cheio de maluco no mundo'
item.description: President Lula stated he will include national defense in his government plan for the 2026 elections, emphasizing the need to equip the Armed Forces due to global instability. He said there is 'a lot of crazy people in the world,' justifying military strengthening as a national security measure.

item.title: Advogado questiona intenção do vídeo de Michelle e avalia o tamanho do impacto para Flávio
item.description: Lawyer André Marsiglia assesses that Michelle Bolsonaro's video, although presented as a spontaneous outburst, was carefully planned, featuring teleprompter use and prior production. He finds the timing of the release odd and not strategically beneficial for Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy, and believes the episode, despite media attention, is unlikely to have significant electoral impact, as it could have been resolved privately.

item.title: Lula diz que incluirá defesa nacional em plano de governo à reeleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced he will include national defense as a priority in his 2026 re-election government plan, stressing the urgent need for strategic investments. He argued that defense must go beyond replacing damaged equipment and instead focus on a long-term project to safeguard Brazil’s sovereignty over its 8.5 million km² territory and 215 million people. The remarks were made during the launch of the frigate 'Cunha Moreira', part of the Tamandaré-class frigates program under the New Industry Brazil initiative.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio transfere QG para SP e mira aproximação com Tarcísio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential campaign has moved its communications headquarters from Brasília to São Paulo, with completion expected in early July, seeking improved logistics and strategic positioning. The shift aims to streamline campaign material distribution, foster proximity to Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), and enhance outreach in key states such as Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Apesar do vídeo de Michelle, Valdemar conseguiu ver o jogo do Brasil nos EUA
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto returned early to Brazil to meet in person with Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro, aiming to contain the public dispute sparked by a video published by the former first lady. The meeting followed Michelle's release of a controversial video that caused tension within the political circle. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: A pedido de Lula, ministro da Defesa irá à Venezuela na próxima semana
item.description: President Lula ordered Defense Minister José Múcio Monteiro to travel to Venezuela next week to assess how Brazil's Armed Forces can assist the country following earthquakes of magnitudes 7.2 and 7.5 on the Richter scale, which have left 589 dead and 2,900 injured. The directive was given during a Navy event in Itajaí (SC), followed by a minute of silence for the victims. The Brazilian Air Force (FAB) has already dispatched a plane with search teams, while civil society groups estimate over 40,000 people are missing.

item.title: Lula diz que está 'cheio de nego maluco no mundo' e afirma que Trump quer tomar Panamá e Groenlândia
item.description: President Lula stated that the world is 'full of crazy people' and criticized Donald Trump for threatening to annex the Panama Canal, Greenland, and Canada. He urged Brazil to invest in defense and prepare for rising international tensions, emphasizing national sovereignty. Lula also warned that the U.S. designation of Brazilian gangs CV and PCC as terrorists could be used to justify foreign military action in Brazil.

item.title: Lula diz que vai ampliar gastos em defesa porque 'está cheio de maluco no mundo': 'Não quero guerra nem ser pego de surpresa'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil will need to increase defense investments due to international instability and the presence of 'crazy people in the world', citing U.S. President's remarks on Greenland, Canada, and the Panama Canal. He emphasized that while he does not want war, he also does not want to be caught off guard, advocating for a long-term strategic project for the Armed Forces as a national priority.

item.title: Valdemar sobre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Se não nos entendermos, vamos perder a eleição’
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto warned that the PL must resolve the conflict between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro to avoid electoral defeat in 2026, stating that disagreement could keep Jair Bolsonaro imprisoned for ten more years. He defended the alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará as the only way to beat the PT and urged Michelle to support the strategy, highlighting her importance in mobilizing female voters.

item.title: Lula e Teresa Leitão se reúnem na 2ª feira
item.description: President Lula met with Senate government leader Teresa Leitão on Monday (June 29, 2026), their first meeting since she assumed the role, to discuss legislative priorities such as ending the 6x1 work scale and the Security PEC. Leitão took over after Jaques Wagner stepped down amid allegations in the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates possible corruption involving public agents and financial institutions. The PT Senate caucus is expected to elect Beto Faro as the new PT leader on Tuesday (June 30), given he is not running for elective office in 2026.

item.title: TSE suspende prazos processuais durante o recesso forense, de 2 a 31 de julho
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) suspended procedural deadlines during the judicial recess from July 2 to July 31, 2026, as established by TSE Ordinance No. 372/2026 published in the Electronic Justice Diary. Deadlines beginning or ending during this period will be automatically extended to the first subsequent business day, August 3, 2026.

item.title: Crusoé: A batalha de versículos entre Michelle e Fernanda Bolsonaro
item.description: The feud between Michelle and Fernanda Bolsonaro escalated on social media through a biblical verse exchange: Michelle cited Psalm 34:13 to accuse Fernanda of lying, while Fernanda responded with Proverbs 6:16-19, listing behaviors God detests. The conflict unfolds as PL leadership attempts to ease tensions between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lindbergh recorre ao STF contra André Mendonça na relatoria do caso ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a regulatory appeal with the STF against President Edson Fachin’s decision to assign Minister André Mendonça as rapporteur in the 'Dark Horse' film financing case. Lindbergh contends there is no demonstrated legal connection between this case and Mendonça’s existing proceedings involving Banco Master and banker Daniel Vorcaro, arguing that chronological precedence alone does not justify preventive jurisdiction, and requests reconsideration or collegiate review.

item.title: Copa do Mundo: Por que o Brasil não enfrentará um terceiro colocado na segunda fase?
item.description: With the new 2026 World Cup format featuring 48 teams and a round of 32, Brazil, as Group C winner, will not face a third-place team in the first knockout round. FIFA's rules dictate that winners of Groups C, F, H and J play second-place teams from other groups, while only winners of Groups A, B, D, E, G, I, K and L face qualified third-place teams. Brazil will face Japan, the Group F runner-up, in Houston on the 29th.

item.title: TSE terá ponto facultativo na segunda (29) em razão de jogo da Seleção Brasileira na Copa do Mundo
item.description: The TSE will have a facultative point on Monday (29) due to the Brazilian national team's match in the 2026 World Cup, per TSE Ordinance No. 376/2026. Essential services must be maintained with an exceptional schedule from 8 a.m. to 12 p.m., and procedural deadlines starting or ending on that day are automatically postponed to Tuesday (30).

item.title: Conselho de Ética analisa pareceres sobre processos por quebra de decoro e ouve testumunhas
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Council meets on Tuesday (30) to review preliminary opinions on misconduct complaints against deputies Paulo Bilynskyj (PL-SP), Rogério Correia (PT-MG) and Erika Hilton (Psol-SP), and to hear witnesses in the case against André Janones (Avante-MG), accused of demanding refunds from staff salaries to benefit his campaign.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula vai a lançamento de fragata em Itajaí (SC)
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attends the launching and christening ceremony of the frigate Cunha Moreira (F202) in Itajaí (SC) on Friday, June 26, 2026. The vessel, the third of the Tamandaré-class, is fully built in Brazil and part of the National Defense Industrial Base strengthening program, emphasizing national labor, technology transfer, and protection of the Blue Amazon.

item.title: Lula discutirá ampliação do fundo do Mercosul no Paraguai
item.description: President Lula will announce in Asunción, Paraguay, on June 30, an increase in Brazil’s investment in the Focem, the Mercosul Structural Convergence Fund, currently financed at 70% by Brazil (US$70 million). The summit will also formalize the launch of negotiations for a trade agreement with Japan, although no Japanese officials will attend in person. The meeting will include the presidents of Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay, Bolivia, Chile, and Ecuador, along with representatives from associate countries and regional organizations.

item.title: Devagar, Durigan, que esse negócio com a China não é negócio da China
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan is accused of using the issuance of panda bonds in yuan as a smokescreen to hide rising public spending and inflation, while promoting an anti-American foreign policy under the guise of cooperation with China. The article criticizes the Lula government for maintaining high protectionist tariffs and non-tariff barriers despite claiming to seek increased trade with the U.S., and argues that issuing debt in yuan is more a partisan act than a sound economic strategy.

item.title: ‘Muito sério’: Valdemar antecipa volta ao Brasil após crise entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, announced an early return from abroad to mediate a crisis between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro after she claimed he humiliated her in a video. The party seeks to contain internal damage stemming from Michelle’s opposition to the alliance with Ciro Gomes, which is backed by Jair Bolsonaro’s sons, aiming to prevent electoral setbacks in 2026.

item.title: Michelle usa versículo sobre 'falsa testemunha'; esposa de Flávio rebate
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro cited a biblical verse about 'false witness', likely in response to criticism against her family. Hours later, Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, rebutted with another biblical passage about a 'lying tongue', signaling a religiously framed exchange of accusations.

item.title: Rubio responde a carta de Flávio Bolsonaro e reforça defesa de tarifas contra o Brasil
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio replied to a letter from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, reaffirming the U.S. intention to impose new tariffs on Brazil due to trade practices deemed harmful by Washington and supporting the designation of Brazilian criminal factions PCC and CV as global terrorists. He thanked Bolsonaro for his support of the anti-terrorism measure and emphasized the importance of a U.S.-Brazil partnership rooted in shared values, despite ongoing trade disputes.

item.title: Caso do filme 'Dark Horse' pode levar PF a abrir até 3 inquéritos nos próximos dias
item.description: The Federal Police is expected to open up to three investigations in the coming days regarding the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', examining R$ 61 million in transfers from Daniel Vorcaro at the request of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, potential use of those funds to support Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S., and the direction of parliamentary amendments to entities linked to the film’s producer. The STF has assigned Justice André Mendonça as the rapporteur for the main inquiry, rejecting a request for Justice Alexandre de Moraes to lead it due to his prior role in Eduardo Bolsonaro’s coercion case. Documents suggest links between the film’s producer, the PCC, and the fraud network tied to the former Banco Master.

item.title: Caso Eletrozema explica resistência de Zema a divulgar isenções fiscais em MG
item.description: Romeu Zema defended the secrecy of fiscal exemptions in Minas Gerais, claiming that disclosing the beneficiary companies would be harmful. The revelation that Eletrozema avoided paying R$ 2.2 million in taxes suggests the real motive behind the secrecy may be tied to specific interests, not the state's welfare.

item.title: Direita zoa Casimiro por apoiar Lula e “virar alvo” do governo
item.description: Right-wing politicians criticize Casimiro Miguel for supporting Lula in 2022 and now being targeted by a Ministry of Justice investigation into CazéTV over alleged irregular gambling advertisements during Copa 2026 broadcasts. CazéTV announced it will adopt a more conservative standard for gambling brand activations to preserve spontaneity and ensure responsibility and transparency.

item.title: ‘Ex-bolsonarista’ escapa de processo por difamação após se retratar com Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Nunes Marques extinguished the criminal liability of federal deputy Otoni de Paula for defamation against Minister Alexandre de Moraes following two public retractions made in 2020 and 2025. However, Otoni remains charged with insult and obstruction of justice, which are not nullified by retractions. The former Bolsonaro ally, now critical of the ex-president, publicly apologized for calling Moraes 'trash', 'scoundrel', and other slurs during live streams.

item.title: Investigação sobre financiamento de Dark Horse fica nas mãos de Mendonça
item.description: Minister André Mendonça will serve as rapporteur for the investigation into the alleged R$134 million financing by former banker Daniel Vorcaro to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for the film Dark Horse, a decision made by STF President Edson Fachin. The rapporteurship was assigned by prevention, as the facts are more closely tied to the Banco Master fraud investigation—already under Mendonça’s responsibility—than to Alexandre de Moraes’ coup-related inquiry. Both Flávio Bolsonaro’s defense and the PGR endorsed Mendonça’s appointment.
